title: Simulation-guided adaptive trials 的 operating characteristics
statement: 複雜adaptive/master/biomarker-enriched trial在多種真實parameter scenarios下是否維持type-I/FDR control、power與合理decision probabilities。
known_result: 2026 Nature Reviews Drug Discovery明確將trial simulation用於type I error、FDR、power與adaptive decision operating characteristics。
open_gap: simulation scenario completeness、model misspecification、rare subgroups與operational deviations。
first_task: 建立two-arm group-sequential toy trial，先用解析結果驗simulation；再加入adaptive sample-size rule。
evaluator: type-I error、power、expected N、stopping probabilities、Monte Carlo SE。
validation_limits: simulation只對所列scenarios有效；不能以一組favorable scenarios證design普遍安全。
completion_criterion: 在預註冊parameter grid及independent code implementation中維持目標operating characteristics。
screening_note: 2026-09-28 初始有界文獻篩查。本庫只做研究方法、公開/去識別資料與simulation，不提供個人診療或自動臨床決策。每輪重查最新指南、驗證研究與修訂。

sources.title: Design, simulate, refine: simulation-guided clinical trials for accelerated drug development
